SPEC-046 owns native plugins and its 19 tasks (T016–T019 are an unpublished stale-registry defect fix); external candidacy approvals remain pending. SPEC-047 adds default-off local aggregate telemetry. Existing Luna review is bound to b2cf477fe9f9; integration adaptations and resulting candidate have separate review/validation. Pilot NO-GO; T017/T018/T010, native observations, ADR adoption, human/founder acceptance and M4.5 closure remain open. Closed 2026-10-31 by founder decision (specs/044-ai-tooling-evaluation/owner-decision-20261031-m45-closure.md, PR #799); remaining native-evaluation, submission and alias work moved to the Deferred milestone.
milestones.FC.2 — Local forecasting capabilities: Local default-off API/CLI/MCP forecasting, synthetic engineering/reproduction and separately approved actual Chronos CPU conformance; no real workload utility or promotion implied. Closed 2026-10-31 by founder decision; human review remains pending.
milestones.HAR.1 — Braid Harness laboratory: Provide a native Agent Braid mechanism to propose, probe and compose small task-local harness variants against an immutable base, first with deterministic fixtures and later through separately qualified Codex/Claude adapters. Draft planning; no due date, native acceptance or activation implied. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
milestones.HAR.2 — Braid Harness evaluation and lea: Determine separately whether harness refinement improves long-task continuity and agent coordination, then retain only scoped evidence-supported lessons and make explicit human or future automatic promotion decisions. Draft planning; no due date, native acceptance or activation implied. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
milestones.HAR.3 — Braid Harness adaptation and int: Implement staged Braid Harness component profiles, skills/helpers/hooks, delegated orchestration, measured depth/width refinement, scoped curation, disabled automatic-policy software and opt-in lifecycle/product integration. Draft planning; native qualification, exact policy adoption and activation remain separate. EUR 0 extra spend.
milestones.M4.6 — Claude Code dynamic workflows: Read-only Agent Braid evidence for Claude Code dynamic workflows and orchestrator-style parallel agents: integration gate (SPEC-052), G0-gated transcript adapter (SPEC-053), advisory ownership/pre-flight/checkpoint/recovery core (SPEC-057), G1-gated opt-in guard (SPEC-058) and G2-gated ledger/push (SPEC-059); planning only, no execution authority. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
milestones.Deferred: Work parked by the founder on 2026-10-31 until its reopen criteria hold: SPEC-029 T001 source permissions granted and admitted real groups greater than zero. Parent issues stay open; nothing here is accepted, cancelled or authorized. See docs/development/FOUNDER_DECISIONS_20261031.md.
milestones.VIS.1 — Activity viewer: Read-only, loopback-only companion that turns Agent Braid artifacts and allowlisted Claude Code and Codex telemetry into the agent-braid-loom/v0.1 event stream and a local Three.js braid viewer with live delivery, replay and explicit minimal export. Independent track; never gates the core, M4.x or HAR. No execution authority, no telemetry persistence, effort kept in memory. Draft planning; no due date, host acceptance or release implied. Extra cash spend EUR 0.
